project: Super Mario All-Stars (25th Anniversary Edition) native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Boots to the title screen and the game-select screen. The game switches the video to PAL 50 Hz and runs at its own 50 fps. Known issue: on the game-select screen two game boxes are drawn over each other. Tested on Windows 11 (RTX 3070 Ti) and on a Linux mini PC (Ryzen 3 4350GE, Vega 6) with scripted inputs; nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
